readme:
# HotNigerianJobs Scraper Scrape job ads from HotNigerianJobs ([hotnigerianjobs.com](https://www.hotnigerianjobs.com/)), a Nigerian job board. You get the title, company, location, salary when the ad states one, the number of positions, the hiring level and the posting date of every ad. Turn on the job page option to add the full text, the position blocks of multi-job ads, the application deadline and how to apply. Browse by state, region, job field, role, industry, qualification or field of study. ## What you get - One row per ad, with a clean ISO posting date and parsed salary numbers when the ad text states a salary. - Optional job page details: full description as HTML and plain text, one block per position of a multi-job ad (title, location, requirements, salary), application deadline and how-to-apply text with the public e-mail addresses and links exactly as shown. - Each ad once per run, even when several category values find it. - A run with no input returns the 20 newest ads of the site. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/hotnigerianjobs-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `hotnigerianjobs-jobs-scraper` to find up to 50 jobs in the field Engineering in the state Lagos, with includeDetails turned on to get how to apply. Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 20, "maxResultsPerQuery": 20 } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `locations` | States such as Lagos, Abuja (FCT), Rivers or Oyo, or Remote or Hybrid. The numeric id of the site works too. | | `regions` | North Central, North East, North West, South East, South South or South West. | | `fields` | Job fields such as Engineering, Administration or Marketing, by short or full name. | | `roles` | Roles such as Driver, Software Engineer or Account Officer. | | `industries` | Industries such as Banking / Financial Services or Construction and Real Estate. | | `qualifications` | Qualifications such as HND or OND. | | `disciplines` | Fields of study such as Accountancy. A name that is both a faculty and a course (Agriculture) reads both. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Ads per category value. Default 50, up to 1000. 0 means 1000. | | `maxResults` | Ads in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false, same price. | Names are matched against the lists of the site (63 fields, 318 roles, 36 industries, 44 qualifications, 162 fields of study, 39 locations, 6 regions). A value that is not in a list is skipped with a warning. With no category the run reads the newest ads of the whole site. There is no keyword search. The search box of HotNigerianJobs is a Google custom search, which cannot be read, so the category lists are the way to find ads. A `searchQueries` input is ignored with a warning. The site filters by one category at a time (the address has one category and one id), so category values cannot be combined into one filter. Each value is read as its own run of pages, and an ad found twice is returned once. Only the main result list of a page counts; the block of about 50 links beside it (the latest ads of the site) is never returned. ## Sample output ```json { "id": "988804", "title": "African Industries Group (AIG) Graduate & Exp. Job Recruitment (3 Positions)", "slug": "african-industries-group-aig-graduate-exp-job-recr", "job_title": null, "company": "African Industries Group (AIG)", "positions_count": 3, "hiring_level": "Graduate & Exp.", "work_mode": null, "location": "Lagos State", "salary_text": null, "salary_min": null, "salary_max": null, "salary_currency": null, "salary_period": null, "posted_text": "Tue 10th Nov, 2026", "date_posted": "2026-11-10", "comments_count": 0, "snippet": "African Industries Group (AIG) is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the following graduate and experienced positions in Lagos State: Graduate Engineer Trainee, Shift-In-Charge - Mechanical, and Environmental Engineer.", "description_html": "

African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 53 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nige...", "description_text": "African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 53 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nigeria’s socio-econom...", "positions": [ { "title": "Graduate Engineer Trainee", "location": "Lagos", "salary": "N150,000 monthly", "deadline": "8th December, 2026", "url": "https://www.hotnigerianjobs.com/hotjobs/988715/graduate-engineer-trainee-at-african-industries-gr.html" }, { "title": "Shift-In-Charge - Mechanical", "location": "Lagos", "deadline": "Not Specified", "url": "https://www.hotnigerianjobs.com/hotjobs/986459/shiftincharge-mechanical-at-african-industries-gro.html" }, { "title": "Environmental Engineer", "location": "Lagos", "salary": "N250,000 - N350,000 monthly", "deadline": "Not Specified", "url": "https://www.hotnigerianjobs.com/hotjobs/986135/environmental-engineer-at-african-industries-group.html" } ], "application_deadline": "2026-12-08", "application_deadline_text": "8th December, 2026", "how_to_apply": null, "apply_emails": [], "apply_urls": [], "job_url": "https://www.hotnigerianjobs.com/hotjobs/988804/african-industries-group-aig-graduate-exp-job-recr.html", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "all jobs", "source": "hotnigerianjobs.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T15:00:00Z" } ``` Columns marked "Needs the job page" are empty (`null`, or an empty list) when `includeDetails` is off. The columns `how_to_apply`, `apply_emails` and `apply_urls` are filled only on job pages that show an apply section, an e-mail address or an off-site link. ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Ad number: the number in the ad address /hotjobs//.html. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Ad title as shown on the list. | | `slug` | string | Text part of the ad address. | | `job_title` | string, null | Role of a single ad ("Role at Company" titles). Null for multi-position ads. A heuristic from the title. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company read from the title. Null when the ad is anonymous (a Reputable Company). A heuristic from the title. | | `positions_count` | number, null | Number of positions when the title states it, for example (3 Positions). | | `hiring_level` | string, null | Level words of a recruitment title, for example Graduate & Exp. or Internship. | | `work_mode` | string, null | Remote, Hybrid or On-site when the title or the card text says so. | | `location` | string, null | Place stated in the card text (for example Lagos State). A heuristic: null when the text names none. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as stated in the card text. Only some ads state one. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound of the stated salary. A single amount is both bounds. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound of the stated salary. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | NGN, USD, GBP or EUR, from the currency sign. | | `salary_period` | string, null | month, year, week, day or hour when the text says so. | | `posted_text` | string, null | Date as shown on the list ("Tue 10th Nov, 2026"). | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date as ISO date. | | `comments_count` | number | Number of reader comments shown on the list. | | `snippet` | string, null | Short text of the ad as shown on the list. | | `description_html` | string, null | Full ad text as HTML. Needs the job page. | | `description_text` | string, null | Full ad text as plain text. Needs the job page. | | `positions` | array | One block per position of a multi-job ad: title, location, requirements, salary, deadline and link when shown. Empty for a single ad. Needs the job page. | | `application_deadline` | string, null | Latest readable deadline as ISO date. Needs the job page. | | `application_deadline_text` | string, null | Deadline as written ("Not Specified" is left out). Needs the job page. | | `how_to_apply` | string, null | Text of the how-to-apply section as shown. Needs the job page. | | `apply_emails` | array | Public e-mail addresses of the apply section, exactly as shown. Needs the job page. | | `apply_urls` | array | Off-site links of the ad, for example an application form. Needs the job page. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the ad on hotnigerianjobs.com. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | Category value that found the ad, or "all jobs" for a run without category. | | `source` | string | Site the ad comes from (hotnigerianjobs.com). | | `scraped_at` | string | Time of the scrape, ISO 8601 UTC. | ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each ad in the dataset. You are never charged for an ad twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0009 per job result ($0.90 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. - [Glassdoor Jobs Scraper - Salaries, Ratings, 20+ Countries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/glassdoor-scraper): Glassdoor jobs with salaries and ratings in 20+ countries. - [Jobrapido Scraper - Multi-Country Job Aggregator](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobrapido-scraper): Multi-country job aggregator Jobrapido. - [Naukri Scraper - India & Middle East Jobs, Salaries, Skills](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/naukri-scraper): Jobs from Naukri in India and the Middle East. ## FAQ **Can I search by keyword?** No. The search of HotNigerianJobs is a Google custom search that cannot be read. Use the categories: roles, fields, industries, qualifications, fields of study, locations and regions. **Can I combine a location with a role?** No. The site filters by one category at a time, so each value is read as its own run of pages. Ads found by several values are returned once. Narrow the result with `maxResultsPerQuery`. **Why are company, role and location sometimes empty?** The list has no separate fields for them. They are read from the title and the card text, so they are empty when the text does not state them, for example for ads from an anonymous recruiter. **What happens when a category has no ads?** The run ends normally with a status such as "0 jobs found for role: Wizard." and nothing is charged. Some categories are empty on the site: in the saved test pages the field of study Agriculture (601) shows "No Result". **What does a multi-job ad return?** One row for the ad. With `includeDetails` on, the `positions` list holds one block per position with its title, location, requirements and salary as shown. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/hotnigerianjobs-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
